newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Guangdong Inv unit sets US$60 mln loan.
newsitem.headline: Guangdong Inv unit sets US$60 mln loan.

text.p: The following syndicated loan issue was announced by arranger International Bank of Asia.
BORROWER GUANGDONG (HK) TOURS CO LTD
GUARANTOR GUANGDONG INVESTMENT LTD
AMOUNT US$60 MLN TYPE TRANSFERABLE TERM LOAN
MARGIN 6ML+135BP MATURITY 5 YRS AVGE LIFE --
PUTS YR 3** CALLS NONE HOME CTRY HONG KONG
DRAWDOWN -- AVAIL 3 MTHS REPAYMENT BULLET
NOTES THE ISSUE IS THE FIRST SYNDICATED LOAN FOR THE
BORROWER, WHICH IS WHOLLY OWNED BY GUANGDONG
INVESTMENT. IT IS SECURED BY A NEGATIVE PLEDGE AND
FINANCIAL COVENANTS. PROCEEDS WILL BE USED FOR
REFINANCING EXISTING DEBTS AND FOR WORKING CAPITAL.
ARRANGERS BANK OF HAWAII HONG KONG BRANCH, ICBC HONG KONG
BRANCH, INTERNATIONAL BANK OF ASIA (AGENT) AND KOREA
FIRST FINANCE.
MGT FEES 90BP FOR COMMITTING US$5 MILLION
80BP FOR COMMITTING US$3 MILLION
70BP FOR COMMITTING US$2 MILLION.
**THERE IS AN ADDITIONAL FEE OF 50BP PAYABLE IN THE
FOURTH YEAR IF THE PUT OPTION IS NOT EXERCISED.
-- Hong Kong Newsroom (852) 2843 6960
